_note: Citizen visits. Triggers are in src/sim/visits.ts, keyed by id; everything else is here. Placeholders: {name}, {home}, {floor}; for the doctor and the delegate (F-018) also {cause} (the diagnosis cause's text), {what} (its short label), {amount} (what it costs) and {fix}. concerns: when the doctor (health) and a residents' delegate (happiness) come about a diagnosis cause. A cause counts once it drains health at all, or costs happiness problemPoints or more, and is fixed once it no longer drains health, or costs less than fixedPoints; skip leaves causes to other visits (noise_complaint) or to the doctor (holeHealth). They come once it has held holdDays: the first time about a cause only to tell you (the _note kinds), then, repeatDays after the last visit about it, asking for a promise (the _promise kinds).

visits.title: Noise complaint
visits.text: {name} is here about the {home} on floor {floor}. "Nobody in our block has slept properly for months. Something has to give."

ignored.message: {name} gave up waiting. The {home} is grumbling about the noise.

choices.label: I'll fix it within 3 months
choices.hint: Move the noise away or buffer it with a corridor.

kept.message: {name} thanks you: the {home} is sleeping again.

broken.message: {name} says you broke your promise about the noise.

choices.label: Enact quiet hours
choices.hint: Ordinance: noise felt at home halved; noisy rooms 5% slower.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.hint: "That noise is the sound of air."

visits.title: Room demand: a clinic
visits.text: {name} speaks for the colonists: "Someone is going to get hurt down here, and there's nowhere to go. We need a clinic."

ignored.message: {name} left the office without an answer. People are asking why.

choices.label: You'll have one within 5 months
choices.hint: Build a clinic (needs brick, metal and electronics).

kept.message: The clinic is open. {name} is telling everyone you kept your word.

broken.message: Still no clinic. {name} is telling everyone you broke your word.

choices.label: Not yet: there are bigger priorities
choices.hint: Loyalty and happiness drop a little.

visits.title: The doctor's report
visits.text: {name} has been keeping an eye on everyone's health. "{cause}. It's costing us {amount}. {fix}"

choices.label: Noted, thank you
choices.hint: Nothing more for now. If it lasts, they'll be back to ask you to fix it.

visits.title: The doctor wants it fixed
visits.text: {name} is back. "{cause}, still. It's costing us {amount}. {fix} Can you sort it out?"

ignored.message: {name} gave up waiting. Word is the doctor's worried and you weren't listening.

choices.label: I'll fix it within 3 months
choices.hint: Kept: loyalty and happiness. Broken: loyalty.

kept.message: {name} thanks you for fixing it ({what}): one less thing for the doctor to worry about.

broken.message: {name} says you broke your promise to fix it ({what}).

choices.label: Not now
choices.hint: Loyalty and happiness drop a little.

visits.title: A word from the residents
visits.text: {name} speaks for the residents. "{cause}. It's costing us {amount}. {fix}"

choices.label: Noted, thank you
choices.hint: Nothing more for now. If it lasts, they'll be back to ask you to fix it.

visits.title: The residents want it fixed
visits.text: {name} is back for the residents. "{cause}, still. It's costing us {amount}. {fix} Will you do something about it?"

ignored.message: {name} gave up waiting. The residents feel ignored.

choices.label: I'll fix it within 3 months
choices.hint: Kept: loyalty and happiness. Broken: loyalty.

kept.message: {name} thanks you, for the residents, for fixing it ({what}).

broken.message: {name} says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it ({what}).

choices.label: Not now
choices.hint: Loyalty and happiness drop a little.
